GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (6 Nov 45) LS
(SCAPIN - 903)
APO 500
26 April 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, dated 6 November 1945, file and subject as above, wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one ImaI, Yoshio, to the Commanding General, XI Corps, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest practicable date, is hereby amended to delete said IMAI's name. This name appears as the second name in the Kamioka Camp, Osaka Area, page No. 8 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
